seoDescription: Post-quantum cryptography in FPGA: lattice arithmetic, NTT butterflies and constant-time control for the algorithms that outlive RSA.

sections.heading: The Post-Quantum Post Office
sections.body: A full-stack post-quantum capability: FIPS-203-exact ML-KEM compression RTL and a 31-module ML-DSA datapath in VHDL-2008, C protocol stacks that sign and encrypt IEC 61850 GOOSE/SV frames, and a KAT backbone tying every layer to the NIST reference via liboqs.

sections.heading: POST-QUANTUM CRYPTOGRAPHY & CRYPTO SUITE
sections.body: Every key is a letter. ML-KEM seals it in an envelope, ML-DSA stamps the postmark, and somewhere a man in a long coat is keeping copies for the day he owns a quantum computer.
Dear Receiver — enclosed is one shared secret, wrapped in 256 noisy coefficients. Only your private key can find it. Burn after decapsulation.

sections.heading: rtl/kyber · 31 files
sections.body: KeyGen, Encaps, Decaps over Z₃₃₂₉. NTT/INTT, Barrett and Montgomery reduction, CBD noise sampling, exact-rounding Compress/Decompress.

sections.heading: rtl/dilithium · 31 modules
sections.body: ML-DSA datapath over Z₈₃₈₀₄₁₇ with twiddle tables. Leaf arithmetic passes its testbenches; C stack signs GOOSE/SV frames.

items.label: quote
items.value: He stamps the postmark, so the receiver knows who really sent it.

sections.heading: The threat model
sections.body: Records ciphertext today, decrypts it once Shor's algorithm runs at scale. The lab's qubit-shor-fpga project models why this program exists.

items.label: quote
items.value: He does not open letters. He files them, and waits.

sections.heading: What is in the coat
sections.body: Demo-grade, not secure. Round-3 Kyber, stubbed entropy, Dilithium controllers still stubs. See section 04.

sections.heading: FIG 1 · COMPRESS_d DEVIATIONS
sections.body: Pre-fix used M = 5039, +1665. Current uses M = 1290168, +q/2. Checked in exact rationals against round(2^d/q · x) mod 2^d.

sections.body: The RTL is right; the vectors predate the fix. The receipt says the letter arrived late because the clock on the wall was wrong.

sections.heading: The Dealer Opens His Coat
sections.kicker: "Demo-grade crypto, not secure crypto. Take a look before you pay."

items.detail: Kyber encaps hardcodes a zero message and draws noise from an LFSR, not SHAKE. ISSUE-002, open. KATs validate arithmetic, not entropy.
rtl/kyber is CRYSTALS-Kyber Round-3, not FIPS-203. Domain separation, K-PKE wrapper and FO implicit-reject are unimplemented.
rtl/dilithium is not proven end-to-end. dilithium_top instantiates stubs for keygen, sign and verify controllers.
The Encryption_Algos Dilithium scaffold is non-functional by its own header; kept in archive/ for ADR-002.
